band.title: Before an order
band.pipeline: Before an order, in life order
band.info: Everything of this customer before an order, each record in exactly one group: what the customer is still writing, what waits on us, the quotes on their way, what waits for the customer — then what ended. Each number opens exactly its rows below.
band.failed: The counts could not be read just now: the lists below still show every record.

why.WRITING: drafts in the customer’s portal: read only, never counted as waiting on us
why.TO_ANSWER: requests New or In progress, and portal orders sent: they wait on us
why.PREPARING: quotes in Draft, or Approved and not sent yet
why.WAITING_CUSTOMER: quotes sent, and requests where we asked for more information
why.ORDER_WAITS: the customer said yes; its order is not made yet
why.WON: accepted quotes with their order, requests and portal orders that became an order
why.MOVED: requests and portal orders that became a quote: the quote carries on
why.LOST: quotes declined, expired or cancelled; requests declined, lost or withdrawn; portal orders not accepted or withdrawn
why.OPEN_QUOTES: quotes in Draft, waiting for approval, Approved or Sent

sec.writingSub: drafts in {customer}’s portal · read only · never counted as waiting on us

empty.tab: {customer} has nothing before an order yet: no request, no quote, no draft.
empty.tabBody: A request from {customer}’s portal lands here by itself.
empty.incomingNone: No request or portal order from {customer} yet.

fold.incoming: No request or portal order in this group.

note.noRequests: Requests and portal orders are not shown: your role does not read requests.
note.noQuotes: Quotes are not shown: your role does not read quotes.
note.noTab: Quotes & incoming needs the right to read quotes or requests: this is the Work tab, which your role may open.

held.notOpen: None of the {count} is open: a closed quote is never cancelled.
held.notDraft: None of the {count} is a draft.
held.noWait: None of the {count} waits for its order.
held.notSent: None of the {count} is sent and waiting for the customer.
held.notRequest: None of the {count} is an open request: a portal order is answered on its own.
held.notAskable: None of the {count} is a request New or In progress.

acts.portalOne_one: {count} portal order is answered one at a time (⋯ on its row): each needs a promise date, prices and a line map.
acts.portalOne_other: {count} portal orders are answered one at a time (⋯ on each row): each needs a promise date, prices and a line map.
acts.noAct: Your role reads these and changes none: there is no act for the ticked rows.

title.newLink_one: Send a new link to {count} quote
title.newLink_other: Send a new link to {count} quotes

body.askApproval: Each draft goes to an approver; its lines are frozen until one decides. The note goes with each.
body.makeOrders: Each accepted quote’s order is made now, from the version the customer accepted.
body.newLink: One mail per quote with the priced PDF and a new accept link; its older link stops.
body.markLost: Each request closes as lost with this note kept on it; a request from the portal reads “Closed” there.
body.askInfo: Each request waits for its customer: one from the portal gets the question there (“We need something from you”), any other by mail to its contact.

why.quoteClosed: Closed: a closed quote is never cancelled.
why.firmOffer: A firm offer: it cannot be withdrawn before its last day ({date}).
why.approvalRefused: Not asked: open the quote to see what stops it.
why.readAgain: Its version is not known yet: read the list again.
why.notSent: Not sent and waiting for the customer.
why.mailFailed: The mail could not be sent: open the quote and try again.
why.portalOwn: A portal order is answered on its own (⋯ on its row).
why.askPortal: A portal order: ask in its own thread.
why.askedAlready: We asked already: it waits for the customer.
why.state: Its state no longer allows it: open it.
why.forbidden: Your role may not do this here.
why.gone: It can no longer be opened.
why.invalid: Refused as it is: open it to see why.
why.later: The server is busy: run the rest again in a moment.
why.failed: It could not be done: run the rest again.

done.askedInfo: Asked: it waits for the customer.
